Title: HTC-28147: RS485 - ESD protection
Purpose: Check if the RS485 signals of the DAA have protection and supports electrostatic discharges.

Inputs.1: 10 positive and negative ESD pulses of 15000 Volts at each RS485 signal of the external connector.

1.Expected: Good functionality of the RS485 transceiver after the application of the pulses.

pass criteria.error: PASS if the checks in the RS485 test are correct after the application of the pulses, otherwise FAIL
